sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red

Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding kalwisz: bearing brackets in red.
Your recorded quality record is 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3).
The recorded demand forecast for part:310020 changed by +20% (fc:310020@2026-09).
PPI-D351 changed by -3.7226% over the referenced annual window (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation and would like an agreement that covers our full need.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and quality record and volume change data you cited, we see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.

Hi! We don't do cost breakdowns, but I checked the volume and index numbers and put them in the price. Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. We really want that faster payment you offered, it helps our cash flow a lot!

Our offer is a price of €50.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. I picked your 1500 ppm package but 500 EUR chargeback is way too much, so I changed it to 150 EUR. Alternatively, with a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint: a price of €47.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Ourangebot is a price of €48.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, and a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. We really need that faster payment you offered to help with our cash flow, but we can't drop the price anymore. Let's just lock it in at 48.00 EUR so we can get these brackets moving!

Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days. We are very eager to work together and build a great long-term partnership with you.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
